newsitem.title: USA: Number Nine appoints VP of marketing.
newsitem.headline: Number Nine appoints VP of marketing.

text.p: Number Nine Visual Technology Corp said Monday it appointed Michael Romanies to be vice president of marketing.

Romanies' previous experience has included marketing and product planning of hardware and software components, systems integration and ASIC products. His immediate responsibility will be to launch two new products: a new 8-megabyte H-VRAM version of the Imagine 128 Series 2, which incorporates a 250-megahertz RAMDAC, and the 9FX Reality 772, which is equipped with 2 or 4MB of VRAM. Beyond that, Romanies will be key in the launch of a third generation of Number Nine's 128-bit technology that will incorporate next generation 3-D capabilities.
Romanies held various positions at REED-Elsevier, a publishing conglomerates. He was vice president and general manager of REED Technology and Information Services Inc.
